subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'wealthy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wealthy** means** someone has a great deal of money or is rich**.

 
 
• *Example - The society seems to favor only the **wealthy **and powerful. *
 
 
 
• Since the king needed finances, it makes sense that he sold the titles to wealthy candidates to gain wealth.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

Correct Passage:__ *The British king, Charles I, had (1) __inherited__ a very difficult financial situation from his father. His period saw a very high rate of inflation. He wanted to (2) __raise__ money. Therefore, he (3) __started__ creating the title of Baronet and selling it to **(4) __wealthy__** candidates. However, his decision was (5) ______ by the British parliament.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

__
 
• **Wealthy **stresses the possession of property and intrinsically valuable things.
 
• **Opulent **suggests lavish expenditure and display of great wealth, **more often applying to things than people.**
 
• The given sentence means that Charles I started creating the title of Baronet and selling it to people who possessed property and intrinsically valuable things.
 
• **Wealthy **is the most appropriate answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the **meaning **of other words:-

 
 
• **Resourceful - **having the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties.
 
• **Opulent - **ostentatiously costly and luxurious.
 
• **Healthy - **in a good physical or mental condition; in good health.

• opulent - धनी
